decisions.reason: The charting bundle extends the established map.apps platform, is under active development with frequent releases, and costs little to carry while its value is still uncertain.
This small search plugin is close to the core offer and cheap to maintain, but it gets only a passing mention, so it carries some risk of being absorbed or quietly retired.
The mobile layer control was featured prominently on the home page and has uncertain but plausible value, so keeping the option open is cheap, though it could later be folded into the platform.
As the flagship platform at the center of the firm's strategic direction, it anchors the other bundles and should be kept and invested in further.
Mobile field data capture fits customer needs, has its own page, and has prospects that remain open, so the option is worth more than its low carrying cost.
This search extension is close to the core offer, cheap to maintain and presented on its own page, so there is no evidence yet that its value has resolved negatively.
